0022600172.text: The Heat enter their seventh game of the season at 2-4, sitting 10th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, one game back, after winning their last two. The Lakers are 4-2 and first in the Pacific, 7th in the West, though they dropped their most recent game. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Heat lost 0-2, most recently 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026.
